title: Elephant waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- elephant body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#9aa8c4'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='58' rx='18' ry='13' fill='#b3c0d8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#7d8bad'/>
  <rect x='44' y='78' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7d8bad'/>
  <rect x='58' y='78' width='9' height='14' rx='4' fill='#7d8bad'/>
  <rect x='68' y='76' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#7d8bad'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='50' r='20' fill='#9aa8c4'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='46' r='13' fill='#b3c0d8'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='42' rx='9' ry='13' fill='#7d8bad'/>
  <ellipse cx='15' cy='42' rx='5' ry='8' fill='#c9a3b8'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#3a2f52'/>
  <circle cx='25.2' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tusk -->
  <path d='M34 60 Q38 66 34 70' stroke='#f4f0e0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- trunk raised waving -->
  <path d='M36 54 Q46 44 42 32 Q40 24 48 20' stroke='#9aa8c4' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 54 Q46 44 42 32 Q40 24 48 20' stroke='#b3c0d8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- trunk tip -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='19' r='5' fill='#9aa8c4'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#c9a3b8'/>
  <!-- waving motion lines -->
  <path d='M56 14 Q60 12 64 14' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 22 Q63 21 67 24' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 60 Q84 58 84 50' stroke='#7d8bad' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='49' r='3' fill='#c9a3b8'/>
</svg>
